industry_analysis.culture: Beauty ideals vary dramatically by culture (skin whitening in Asia, tanning in Western markets). K-beauty multi-step routines influential globally. Clean beauty and minimalism trending. Traditional and herbal ingredients valued in many markets.
industry_analysis.consumer: Premiumization with willingness to pay for proven results. Ingredient literacy increasing (retinol, niacinamide, hyaluronic acid). Social media and influencer reviews drive purchases. Trial sizes and discovery sets popular.
industry_analysis.infra: Cosmetic product safety assessment required (EU CPNP, FDA). INCI ingredient labeling mandatory. Animal testing bans (EU, and expanding). GMP manufacturing facilities required for quality assurance.
industry_analysis.population: Male grooming and skincare expanding. Gen Z driving early adoption of skincare routines. Aging populations fueling anti-aging market. Diverse beauty standards across demographic groups.
industry_analysis.social: Inclusivity and diversity in shade ranges and marketing. Clean beauty and transparency movement. TikTok beauty trends creating viral product demand. Cruelty-free and vegan certifications important.
industry_analysis.environment: Sustainable packaging (refillable, recyclable, PCR materials). Reef-safe sunscreen regulations. Microplastic ingredient bans. Carbon-neutral beauty brand commitments.
industry_analysis.opportunity: Inclusive beauty products for diverse skin tones and types. Men's skincare and cosmetics. Clean and clinical beauty hybrid. Beauty tech devices and personalization.

compliance_summary: Cosmetic safety assessment, FDA/EU cosmetic regulations, INCI ingredient labeling, animal testing bans, GMP manufacturing.
